CRITICAL = truly blocks first drive (chief, crew review 2026-10-22: gates + Mechanic hardware + Sparky). LATER = refine over time.

## 0. Path to first drive — chief's gates (in order)
- **CRITICAL** · Gate 0 — 12 V bench (chief): flash on 12 V only; link fault < 200 ms; Kelly config readback: Boost OFF, High Pedal Disable ON, Foot_SW + 3-gear (F/N/R) behaviour, OV cutoff ≈160 V (PROPOSED value, read back and record). (Chief; BACKLOG.md:5)
- **CRITICAL** · Gate 1 — sensors (chief): BICM cells within 10 mV of a meter; temp / ID mapping; LEM zero at 2.5 V + dead-LEM detect; pedal tracks; park contacts; e-stop NC2; brake override; clamp kill-A / kill-B test with the Kid (Low) cap engaging when unpowered. (Chief; BACKLOG.md:6)
- **CRITICAL** · Gate 2 — one string, wheels up (chief): precharge to 95 %; e-stop; weld check; precharge timeout; turn the safety flags on one at a time. First HV power-up one string at a time (Sparky). (Chief; BACKLOG.md:7)
- **CRITICAL** · Gate 3 — four strings (chief): add strings one at a time, each within 1 V of the others; spin; regen direction; coolant flow; fan at 40 °C; 12 V alarm; HV leak detection. (Chief; BACKLOG.md:8)
- **CRITICAL** · Gate 4 — first drive (chief): Kid / Low mode, 10 mph, flat ground, spotter. (Chief; BACKLOG.md:9)
